svg.title: Denial: the finishing touch was always you

g.font-family: 'Noto Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif
g.text: Let windows glide and catch the light;
No config files to steal your night,
no beauty you must lose to might.
We built the windows. You decide the view.
The finishing touch was always you.
